name: Multilogin
description: Cloud phone and multi-account management platform for running separate Android devices and browser profiles from one dashboard, with tools for account isolation, team collaboration, and automation across social media and web platforms.

events.d: Create or update a browser profile with OS, browser type, fingerprint masking, proxy, storage, tags, and start URLs.
Retrieve all workspaces in your Multilogin account, with optional search by name or email and role filtering.
Create a new folder in the current workspace.
Delete one or more workspace folders by their IDs.

Runs the workflow automatically when workspace folders are listed. Returns folders in the current workspace and supports optional search by name or ID, and filtering to folders that contain profiles or are empty.
Create proxy connection URLs for browser or profile use, specifying session type, protocol, location, count, and IP TTL for rotating sessions.
Retrieve proxy account traffic and billing ID, returning traffic converted to the selected unit (bytes, KB, MB, GB).
Search profiles by text, folder, tags, dates, or user and sort the results.
Easily remove one or multiple Multilogin profiles from your dashboard, managing your Android devices and browser profiles efficiently.
Create a named tag (with optional color) to organize profiles and devices.
